messages.subject: SRMR in multiple imputation CFA
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am currently trying to answer the following question: 

When using multiple imputation CFA via 
runMI
with categorical data, WLSMV estimator, and mice, why is there no SRMR.scaled in
fitMeasures()
? 

Is there a possibility to obtain a scaled SRMR in this case? And if not, would you simply report the non-scaled SRMR with the other scaled fit indices? 

Thank you all in advance for your help.

Best regards,
Jan Brederecke

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: SRMR in multiple imputation CFA
parts: why is there no SRMR.scaled

Because scaled indices are only those that are based on the scaled (robust) chi-squared statistic.  SRMR is based on residuals, not chi-squared.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
